subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should this workflow accept the short-lived review token's Pull requests write capability and use a maintainer proof override for a monitored post-merge validation?
rationale: The GitHub permission is necessary for PR timeline comments but grants a broader mutation capability, and the scheduled default-branch behavior cannot be positively demonstrated from the unmerged branch.

options.title: Approve monitored rollout
options.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, apply an explicit proof override, merge, and validate the next normal PR-and-issue review run.

options.title: Pause for narrower design
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged while investigating an architecture that publishes lease comments outside the review shard or otherwise avoids giving that shard PR-write capability.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, apply an explicit proof override, merge, and validate the next normal PR-and-issue review run.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes a live GitHub App security boundary and deployment proof policy for ClawSweeper's primary workflow.
